text: Q: What programs are offered at ITM University Gwalior? A: ITM University offers UG, PG, Diploma, and Ph.D. programs across Engineering, Management, Computer Applications, Science, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Nursing, Law, Humanities, Fine Arts, and Design.
Q: What is the mode of admission? A: Admissions are granted through inhouse ITM NEST, national-level exams (JEE, CAT, CMAT, NEET), and merit-based admission for selected programs.

Q: How can I apply for admission? A: Visit the official website, fill out the application form, upload documents, appear for entrance test (if applicable), attend counselling/interview, and confirm admission via fee payment. Details at https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/admission/onlineapply
Q: What is the basic eligibility for undergraduate programs? A: 10+2 with a minimum of 45%-60%, depending on the course.
Q: What is the eligibility for B.Tech programs? A: 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, English and minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved categories).
Q: What is the eligibility for management programs (BBA/MBA)? A: BBA: 10+2 with ~50%. MBA: Graduation with minimum 50%.
Q: What is the eligibility for postgraduate programs? A: Bachelor's degree in relevant field with 50% marks.
Q: Are Honours programs available? A: Yes, with higher eligibility (typically 55% or above).
Q: Are integrated programs available? A: Yes, including IPM (Integrated Program in Management).
Q: Is ITM NEST mandatory? A: Not always; alternatives include national exams or merit.
Q: Is lateral entry available? A: Yes, for programs like B.Tech.
Q: What documents are required? A: 10th, 12th, graduation marksheets, scorecards, ID proof, photographs.
Q: Is there an interview or counselling process? A: Yes, for selected programs.
Q: What schools/faculties are available? A: Engineering, Management, Science, Agriculture, Pharmacy, Nursing, Law, Fine Arts.
Q: What is the duration of programs? A: UG: 3-4 years; PG: 2 years; Integrated: up to 5 years.
Q: Does the university support internships? A: Yes, with industry exposure and training.
Q: Are hostel facilities available? A: Yes, with AC/non-AC options, mess, and security.
Q: Are scholarships available? A: Yes, based on merit and institutional policies. Details at https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/scholarship/scholarship_2026
Q: Is ITM University affiliated? A: No, it is an independent private university.
Q: Can international students apply? A: Yes.
Q: Where can I get more details? A: Visit www.itmuniversity.ac.in

Q: How much are the B.Tech fees at ITM University Gwalior? A: B.Tech fees vary by branch, roughly Rs. 4.04 Lakh to Rs. 14 Lakh for the full 4-year program. For the exact, current figure for your branch, check the official Fee Structure PDF at https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/admission/fee-structure
Q: Is there a caution money deposit? A: Yes, Rs. 5,000 caution money is charged, which is refundable after completion of the course.

Q: Does ITM University charge any capitation fee? A: No. ITM University Gwalior states it does not charge any capitation fee beyond its declared fee structure, and provides a receipt for the exact amount paid. Always collect your fee receipt.

Q: What is the placement record of ITM University Gwalior? A: Per the official site, ITM University has recorded 16000+ placement opportunities in the last 3 years, with a highest package of 45 LPA and an average package of 6 LPA (figures as of Aug 2026; check https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/tap-cell/recent-placement for the latest).

Q: Which cell manages training and placements? A: The TAP Cell (Training and Placement Cell) manages placements, along with the XpertQuest leadership development program. More info: https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/tap-cell/about-tapcell

Q: What sports facilities are available on campus? A: The campus has cricket, football, athletics track, basketball, tennis, volleyball, handball, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, and hockey grounds outdoors, plus a gymnasium, badminton court, multi-gym, yoga hall, and table tennis hall indoors.

Q: Are there auditoriums for events? A: Yes - notable venues include the NAAD Amphitheatre (seating 4000), Dr. Ram Manohar Lohiya Auditorium (250), and the Ustaad Allahuddin Khan Auditorium (400), plus several seminar halls.
Q: Is there a hospital on campus? A: Yes, ITM Hospital and Research Center is located on campus. Details: https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/academics/itm-hospital

Q: How do I contact admissions for B.Tech? A: For B.Tech/M.Tech (School of Engineering & Technology), contact Mr. Kapil Sharma or Mr. Rahul Ojha at 9329934215 / 9303769744, or email admission@itmuniversity.ac.in.
Q: What is the toll-free number for ITM University? A: The toll-free number is 1800 270 0031.

Q: Does ITM University have offices outside Gwalior? A: Yes, it has regional counselling offices for North East India, West Bengal, and a Patna office for East India, plus a separate campus in Vadodara, Gujarat.

Q: How do students log in to check attendance, results, or LMS? A: Students use Prabandh (MIS) at https://mis.itmuniversity.ac.in/itmzone/home.php, Tattva (LMS) at https://lms.itmuniversity.ac.in/, and Parakh (E-Praksh) at https://parakh.itmuniversity.ac.in/
